content:
alex_partnerships: Quick sync — draft private offer for CloudMarket + Nvidia reseller. Looking for alignment on commit shape and hardware rebate. Thinking 12m commit with quarterly true-ups.

sara_pm: Sounds good. Do you mean monetary commit or RU-based? We need to map to SKUs for marketplace listing.

alex_partnerships: Monetary commit. Proposal: three tranches:
```
Tier A: $100k/mo commit -> 12% discount + 3% hardware rebate
Tier B: $250k/mo commit -> 18% discount + 5% hardware rebate
Tier C: $500k/mo commit -> 25% discount + 8% hardware rebate
```
quarterly true-ups to avoid over-provisioning, with carryforward credit for unused usage through next quarter.

mike_finance: flagged — rebates as % of committed spend (not on actual usage), okay but we need cap and clawback on early termination. Recommend add: 12m min, 6m phased payout, 18m recovery window.

anya_ops: For Dedicated customers we need a separate SKU mapping. Also SI integration credits: propose 10% of ARR in eligible services credits applied as one-off marketplace coupon.

jordan_si: @anya_ops SI credits look good but need scope doc. We should tie credits to enablement milestones (POC, production) so partners don't just resell.

sara_pm: Renewal automation: convert remaining committed credit to discounted pay-as-you-go rate if customer doesn't renew. Holds for 30d. Also learnings from last year: customers prefer flat monthly committed bucket vs per-SKU, so default to bucketed commit.

mike_finance: Also let's add an annual uplift clause: if usage grows >30% YoY, auto-tier bump with customer notice and opt-out window.

revbot: [system] Marketplace private offer draft uploaded: https://gcs.redwood/marketplace/offers/1887654321-draft.json :eyes: 

alex_partnerships: Thanks — can folks review the draft by EOD Wed? Need final numbers for Marketplace listing + partner contract.

sara_pm: Reviewing now. :thumbsup: 

mike_finance: I'll run a modeling pass and post sensitivity table.

jordan_si: Will draft SI scope and milestone checklist by tomorrow.

anya_ops: Ops checklist: billing config, SKU mapping, quota alerts — I will flag required console changes.

alex_partnerships: Great — follow-ups: 1) finalize rebates cap 2) add clawback language 3) SI milestone doc. Back here Thurs AM.
